en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Students will have an overview of the core principles of social communication including cross-cultural issues. The course introduces the possibilities for self development, knowledge dissemination, the role of various communication channels. Students will understand how people interpret, modify, and respond to the information, the credibility of messages, the role of status and particular interests in the community, transfer of knowledge to local communities and a dialogue.
